eligibility_policy.trigger: Run second-look recognition only when the entire clip produced zero raw 42B-1 issues.

keyframe_policy.rule: Among existing selected keyframes with zero issues, choose the timestamp closest to 2.0 seconds.

views: 9 fixed overlapping fine crops from a 3x3 grid

recognition_policy: Perform an independent conservative second-look recognition pass.
Search for distinctly visible physical rental-property conditions rather than confirming a supplied ground-truth condition.
Pay particular attention to small localized defects, subtle surface repairs, fixture alignment, and geometric displacement.
Do not infer looseness, leaks, hidden causes, or damage that is not visibly supported.
Normal texture, wood grain, seams, reflections, shadows, normal hardware, and cosmetic variation are not defects by themselves.
downstream_policy: Preserve every second-look raw finding separately.
Send qualifying second-look findings through the existing 42B-2 multiscale verifier before accepting them.
Combine accepted second-look findings with already verified 42B-2 findings.
Do not modify frozen Detector v2.

excluded_from_recognition_claim.reason: Its two remaining intervals are temporal-coverage problems rather than the four covered recognition failures.
excluded_from_recognition_claim.followup: Handle rejected-frame rescue and targeted higher-frequency motion sampling separately after 42B-3.
